info.title: The Color Universal API
info.description: Identify colors, convert color formats, and generate color schemes using The Color API.

get.description: Generates a color scheme in The Color from a CMYK seed.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: cmyk
parameters.description: Valid CMYK seed color, such as 100,58,0,33 or cmyk(100,58,0,33).

schema.description: Valid CMYK seed color, such as 100,58,0,33 or cmyk(100,58,0,33).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Scheme mode to generate from the seed color.

schema.description: Scheme mode to generate from the seed color.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of colors to return.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

count.description: Number of colors returned by the API.

bare.description: SVG scheme image URL without names.

named.description: SVG scheme image URL with names.

seed.description: Seed color used to generate the scheme.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Identifies a color in The Color by CMYK value.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: cmyk
parameters.description: Valid CMYK color, such as 100,58,0,33 or cmyk(100,58,0,33).

schema.description: Valid CMYK color, such as 100,58,0,33 or cmyk(100,58,0,33).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

href.description: Self link for the color result.

clean.description: Hex value without the leading hash.

bare.description: SVG image URL without the color name.

named.description: SVG image URL with the color name.

distance.description: Distance from the closest named color.

exact_match_name.description: Whether the supplied color exactly matches the returned name.
